# zig-libpq generated source manifest

# This file is generated by `zig build gen` (gen/gen.py). It describes
# the sources, flags and include directories needed to build libpq, the
# PostgreSQL client library, with any C compiler. It is intentionally
# line oriented and needs no parser.

# Format: one record per line, fields separated by spaces. Blank lines
# and lines starting with '#' are ignored. This is format version 1.

#   version <n>
#       Format version.

#   postgresql <version>
#       The PostgreSQL release.

#   upstream <url> <hash>
#       The exact PostgreSQL source release. <hash> is the Zig package
#       hash.

#   shared-dir <dir>
#       Repository-relative directory of the generated headers every
#       platform shares.

#   header <path> <name>
#       A public header, relative to the PostgreSQL source root. Install
#       it as <name>, relative to the include directory.

#   cflag <group> <flag>
#       A flag for every C compilation in <group>.

#   include <group> <dir>
#       An include directory of <group>, relative to the PostgreSQL
#       source root, in search order. Put the platform's generated
#       directory and then <shared-dir> before all of these.

#   source <group> <path> [<flag>...]
#       C source relative to the PostgreSQL source root, compiled with
#       the flags and include directories of <group> followed by its
#       own <flag>s.

#   platform <arch> <os> <abis> <generated-dir>
#       Starts a platform block. <abis> is a comma-separated list of Zig
#       ABI names. All following records belong to this platform and add
#       to the ones above the first platform block: its cflag and include
#       records go after those of the same group.

#   triple <target>
#       A Zig-style target triple served by the current platform block.

#   link <flag>
#       A linker flag libpq needs on this platform, besides OpenSSL.

# Build notes:
#   - libpq is the "libpq", "common" and "port" groups, compiled into a
#     single library. A group only selects flags and include directories.
#   - Every group includes OpenSSL's headers (4.1.0, from zig-openssl);
#     add its include directory after the ones listed. Link libssl and
#     libcrypto after libpq.
#   - Every record has a unique path. Do not merge records by basename.
#   - Compile position-independent code to link libpq into a shared
#     object.
